title: Fix clamp
prompt: The Go package `clamp` in this module has a bug. Clamp(v, lo, hi) must return v limited to the range lo to hi, both ends included. Fix the code in clamp/clamp.go. Do not add or change any test file.

title: Fix reverse
prompt: The Go package `reverse` in this module has a bug. Reverse(s) must return a new slice with the elements of s in the opposite order, and must not change s. Fix the code in reverse/reverse.go. Do not add or change any test file.

title: Fix dedupe
prompt: The Go package `dedupe` in this module has a bug. Dedupe(s) must return the distinct strings of s in the order they first appear. Fix the code in dedupe/dedupe.go. Do not add or change any test file.

title: Fix median
prompt: The Go package `median` in this module has a bug. Median(xs) must return the middle value of xs once sorted; for an even count, the mean of the two middle values; and 0 for an empty slice. It must not change xs. Fix the code in median/median.go. Do not add or change any test file.

title: Fix wordcount
prompt: The Go package `wordcount` in this module has a bug. Count(s) must return how many words s has, where words are separated by any run of whitespace: spaces, tabs or newlines. Fix the code in wordcount/wordcount.go. Do not add or change any test file.
